checks.name: all API and internal commit schema definitions compile
register-existing request is closed and carries no storage root
generic profile request rejects AI-specific fields
connection credential handles stay opaque strings
client cannot submit a managed installer outcome as a public command
internal operational-only batch is specified independently of RDF units
every logical record field has an explicit physical mapping
diagram scalar types follow schemas rather than Ref suffixes
diagram arrays and external schema structures are resolved
diagram composition preserves optional Hermes specialization
diagram union, cycle and unresolved-reference fallbacks are honest
inspection errors and incomplete scopes mean unknown, not absent
presence classification distinguishes verified copy and scoped absence
fresh inspection permits presence without profiles or running service
expired, changed, rebooted or clock-anomalous proof is unknown
migration planning is deterministic and does not mutate legacy metadata
legacy receipt and partial install never become fresh presence proof
migration retains native handles and external ownership without fake services
synthetic migration replay survives restart without duplicate identities
conflicting legacy identities and changed-source apply require review
proposed additive DDL preserves legacy tables and reaches user_version 4 in memory
exact object and unit composite foreign keys reject dangling/mismatched versions
commit idempotency and alias uniqueness are physical constraints
exact historical reference cannot name a missing stored revision
legacy admission is preserved only through explicit read-only carryover
external service state cannot claim a managed running target
all physical foreign keys remain consistent in the synthetic database
diagram provenance matches every material schema/generator/ontology/DDL input
runtime source and published ontology inputs remain unchanged

limits: Pure presence policy, not native installation inspection
Synthetic migration identity/replay, not full conversion
DDL and schema validation, not HTTP integration or crash/power-loss qualification
Mermaid source/type/provenance checks; no layout renderer available
